38: public class GsonBuilderTest {
39:   private static final TypeAdapter<Object> NULL_TYPE_ADAPTER = new TypeAdapter<Object>() {
40:     @Override public void write(JsonWriter out, Object value) {
41:       throw new AssertionError();
42:     }

48:   @Test
49:   public void testCreatingMoreThanOnce() {
50:     GsonBuilder builder = new GsonBuilder();
51:     Gson gson = builder.create();
52:     assertThat(gson).isNotNull();
53:     assertThat(builder.create()).isNotNull();
54: 
55:     builder.setFieldNamingStrategy(new FieldNamingStrategy() {
56:       @Override public String translateName(Field f) {
57:         return "test";
58:       }
59:     });
60: 
61:     Gson otherGson = builder.create();
62:     assertThat(otherGson).isNotNull();
63:     // Should be different instances because builder has been modified in the meantime
64:     assertThat(gson).isNotSameInstanceAs(otherGson);
65:   }
66: 
67:   /**
68:    * Gson instances should not be affected by subsequent modification of GsonBuilder
69:    * which created them.
70:    */
71:   @Test
72:   public void testModificationAfterCreate() {
73:     GsonBuilder gsonBuilder = new GsonBuilder();
74:     Gson gson = gsonBuilder.create();
75: 
76:     // Modifications of `gsonBuilder` should not affect `gson` object
77:     gsonBuilder.registerTypeAdapter(CustomClass1.class, new TypeAdapter<CustomClass1>() {
78:       @Override public CustomClass1 read(JsonReader in) {
79:         throw new UnsupportedOperationException();
80:       }
81: 
82:       @Override public void write(JsonWriter out, CustomClass1 value) throws IOException {
83:         out.value("custom-adapter");
84:       }
85:     });
86:     gsonBuilder.registerTypeHierarchyAdapter(CustomClass2.class, new JsonSerializer<CustomClass2>() {
87:       @Override public JsonElement serialize(CustomClass2 src, Type typeOfSrc, JsonSerializationContext context) {
88:         return new JsonPrimitive("custom-hierarchy-adapter");
89:       }
90:     });
91:     gsonBuilder.registerTypeAdapter(CustomClass3.class, new InstanceCreator<CustomClass3>() {
92:       @Override public CustomClass3 createInstance(Type type) {
93:         return new CustomClass3("custom-instance");
94:       }
95:     });
96: 
97: 
98:     assertDefaultGson(gson);
99:     // New GsonBuilder created from `gson` should not have been affected by changes
100:     // to `gsonBuilder` either
101:     assertDefaultGson(gson.newBuilder().create());
102: 
103:     // New Gson instance from modified GsonBuilder should be affected by changes
104:     assertCustomGson(gsonBuilder.create());
105:   }

107:   private static void assertDefaultGson(Gson gson) {
108:     // Should use default reflective adapter
109:     String json1 = gson.toJson(new CustomClass1());
110:     assertThat(json1).isEqualTo("{}");
111: 
112:     // Should use default reflective adapter
113:     String json2 = gson.toJson(new CustomClass2());
114:     assertThat(json2).isEqualTo("{}");
115: 
116:     // Should use default instance creator
117:     CustomClass3 customClass3 = gson.fromJson("{}", CustomClass3.class);
118:     assertThat(customClass3.s).isEqualTo(CustomClass3.NO_ARG_CONSTRUCTOR_VALUE);
119:   }

122:     String json1 = gson.toJson(new CustomClass1());
123:     assertThat(json1).isEqualTo("\"custom-adapter\"");
124: 
125:     String json2 = gson.toJson(new CustomClass2());
126:     assertThat(json2).isEqualTo("\"custom-hierarchy-adapter\"");
127: 
128:     CustomClass3 customClass3 = gson.fromJson("{}", CustomClass3.class);
129:     assertThat(customClass3.s).isEqualTo("custom-instance");
130:   }

133:   static class CustomClass2 { }

145:     }
146:   }

151:         .excludeFieldsWithModifiers(Modifier.VOLATILE, Modifier.PRIVATE)
